title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 8.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: .NET 8.0 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux has multiple security vulnerabilities including denial of service, information disclosure, and elevation of privilege issues affecting ASP.NET Core and .NET runtimes. These vulnerabilities are addressed in an update to SDK version 8.0.134 and runtime version 8.0.34. The update is rated as important by Red Hat Product Security and fixes several CVEs related to denial of service, information disclosure, and privilege escalation.
